Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.video

Record Class Theme

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.jengacode.eduvideo.video.Theme
Record Components:
background - background retained by this immutable descriptor
foreground - foreground retained by this immutable descriptor
primary - primary retained by this immutable descriptor
secondary - secondary retained by this immutable descriptor
success - success retained by this immutable descriptor
warning - warning retained by this immutable descriptor
font - font family or measured Font, as required by the overload
public record Theme(Color background, Color foreground, Color primary, Color secondary, Color success, Color warning, String font) extends Record
Palette and typography shared by objects.

Preserves the original seven-component palette constructor and adds semantic derived colours. Named palettes coordinate accents rather than recolouring every item identically. Colours and font must be non-null.
